rubricDispositions.rationale: Focused proof covers the required crash/replay windows, lease expiry/reclaim, stale worker completion, duplicate same-idempotency/different-effect enqueue, retry/permanent/max-attempt states, cancellation/revocation/supersession, typed errors, internal controls, and row schema. The proof packet records a failure-before-repair for the prior DuplicateEffect false-green and passed focused gates for the exact head.

The change stays inside the Confect/Convex jobs boundary for this fixture-to-real swap, registers public/internal functions through the spec/impl tree, and keeps source job status/control as internal functions rather than adding API/MCP tools or UI bypasses.

State transitions are factored into reducer-style helpers with typed Effect Schema errors, leasing is isolated in a small module, and Convex handlers primarily perform lookup/CAS/persistence orchestration without duplicating reducer logic.

The implementation persists attempt receipts and external response hashes while hashing lease tokens in receipts. Tests assert encoded public-safe error tags do not expose raw lease tokens, providing useful redacted diagnostics without logging provider payloads or secrets.

The task exceeded the original estimate, but lane-gate source slicing kept each of the four source slices at or below the 300-line sourceSliceBudget and passed with estimateDrift explicitly recorded. The larger total change is test-heavy and confined to the manifest-owned files for the approved fixture-to-real task.

No generated Confect or Convex files are part of the S06-T01 changedFiles proof, spec imports runtime functions only as type in the spec and runtime values in impl as required, and the exact-head proof packet records passing transient Confect codegen evidence after the history rewrite.
